concepts.gloss_en: Benjamin — the tribe/son (ben-yamin), born in Eretz Yisrael; associated with da'at, mochin, tefillin, and the Temple's location in his portion
Nimin — strands/threads/hairs (נימין בחינת שערות), a distinct word meaning strings/hairs

members.note: proof glosses it as שערות (hairs/strands); not Benjamin minus a ב-clitic — different lexeme entirely

notes: The mechanical clitic signal is a false positive: נימין is not בנימין without the ב prefix. נימין means threads/hairs (=שערות), while בנימין is the proper name Benjamin. Distinct concepts.
